Unlocks a larger low-voltage generator which can be automated and is also slightly more efficient.

While the Burner Generator can burn Biomass, it's advised to automate the process by using Ignium ore mined by Drone Miners.

research.name: Mining Efficiency
research.description:
Allows all mining machines to produce additional items without depleting their respective ore patch or vein. Produces 10% additional free ore items per level, can be researched infinitely. Does not increase the output per minute.

For ore vein core mining it reduces fracking liquid consumption. Each level grants 10% additional free ore items per same amount of fracking liquid required.

research.name: Mining Efficiency (Demo)
research.description:
Increases the resource output of mining machinery by 10% per level. Extra items produced do not deplete the vein. Can be researched repeatedly.

In this demo Mining Efficiency is not visualized at the drone miners screen panel or the tablet, but your miners will be able to extract more ore before it depletes.

research.name: Mining Force I
research.description:
Allows drilling and blasting of deeper underground terrain giving you access to previously unreachable resources.

Also allows the Short Range Scanner to scan for artifacts hidden in areas that require Mining Force I.

research.name: Mining Force II

Allows drilling and blasting of deeper underground terrain giving you access to previously unreachable resources.

Unlocks scanning for Ignium ore with the handheld Ore Scanner. 

Ignium is a burnable element used for power generation. Research the Burner Generator to use it as a fuel source.

research.name: Personal Assistant Robot Assembly
research.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Personal Assistant robots in assembly lines.

research.description: Pipelines provide a high-throughput alternative to pipes. They are mainly required for modular buildings like Blast Furnaces and Hot Air Stoves. They can be connected to pipes through adapter pieces.

research.name: Power Pole (Wall-Mounted)

research.name: Shaped Charge
research.description:
A shaped charge is an explosive which focuses all its energy in a certain direction. They are like regular explosives but due to their precision you know exactly which area will be excavated or destroyed in advance.

Trigger them with the detonator just like the throwable explosive charges.

research.name: Shaped Charge (Heavy)
research.description: A stronger version of the shaped charge which has a larger explosion area and the ability to clear lava cave bedrock and empty reservoirs.

research.description: By extending the hull we can make more space for station upgrades.

research.name: Station: Orbital Laser
research.description:
By installing an orbital laser we can rapidly destroy a lot of terrain, but it'll be pretty messy.

Use the orbital uplink tool to control it.

research.name: Space Station Terminal
research.description: By combining two emergency beacons we might be able to build a terminal capable of making contact to the orbital station.

research.name: Stairs
research.description: Stair blocks to create slopes.

research.name: Radio Tower
research.description: Building a large radio tower allows us to contact the space station from anywhere without needing to go to a terminal.

explorationUnlocks.title: Xeno-Logistics System
explorationUnlocks.description:
The alien scrap provides insight on how to teleport items over short distances. Analysis will allow us to gain sufficient insight to make use of a technology we call Xeno-Logistics.

The system allows us to automatically resupply items from Xeno-Logistics Containers into the character inventory through Xeno-Logistics Towers.

This cannot be used to move items between machines and is no substitution for various factory logistics.

explorationUnlocks.title: Charged Xeno-Crystal Production
explorationUnlocks.description: Unlocks the Crystal Refiner which allows to energize Xeno-Crystals into Charged Xeno-Crystals, which brings us one step closer to unlocking their true potential.

explorationUnlocks.title: Xeno-Crystal Mining
explorationUnlocks.description:
We have found super-condensed veins of Xeno-Crystals inside the lava caves. Similar to the Scrap-Mining we could utilize a specialized mining building to mine Xeno-Crystals from a seemingly endless source.

This also unlocks tracking of such deposits with the Short Range Scanner.

explorationUnlocks.title: Crystal Ore Refinment
explorationUnlocks.description: In case we have excess crystals we could blend them with the ore rubble to reduce our ore consumption.

explorationUnlocks.description: With the all the previous information we have previously gathered, we should now be able to make our own Xeno Power Cores.

We have found super-condensed masses of Xeno-Scrap underground and we can utilize a specialized mining building to mine Xeno-Scrap from a seemingly endless source.

This also unlocks tracking of such deposits with the Short Range Scanner.

explorationUnlocks.title: Scrap Recycling
explorationUnlocks.description: Unlocks the Scrap Recycler which allows to recycle Xeno-Scrap into components we can repurpose for other needs.

explorationUnlocks.title: Short Range Scanner
explorationUnlocks.description:
Unlocks the Short Range Scanner, which allows us to track and locate Xeno-Scrap-Remnants on the surface.

Once unlocked, the scanner will appear at the top left of the screen.

explorationUnlocks.title: Crystal-Scanning
explorationUnlocks.description:
Tunes the short range scanner so that it can track Xeno-Crystals.

Note: Scan range might not be high enough to detect Xeno-Crystals from the surface.

explorationUnlocks.title: Xeno Power Core Scanning
explorationUnlocks.description:
Tunes the short range scanner so that it can track intact Xeno Power Cores.

Note: Scan range might not be high enough to detect those buried pieces from the surface.

explorationUnlocks.title: Large Xeno-Scrap Scanning
explorationUnlocks.description:
Tunes the short range scanner so that it can track larger Xeno-Scrap pieces, which may contain damaged Xeno Power Cores.

Note: Large Xeno-Scrap can be tracked from the surface, but you'll have to explore a bit until you get close enough. Open your scanning frame (default key: J) to customize which objects the Short Range Scanner should track.

explorationUnlocks.title: Cave-Scanning
explorationUnlocks.description:
Tunes the short range scanner so that it can track Xeno-Scrap pieces buried in underground caves where we will be able to find a lot more scrap in a more condensed area.

Open your scanning frame (default key: J) to customize which objects the Short Range Scanner should track.

explorationUnlocks.title: Irrigation Tool
explorationUnlocks.description: The Irrigation Tool shoots a stream of water which allows you to regrow grass on dirt terrain.
